column3: 画面内容
Adrian的房间，奢华，灯光昏暗。冷暖对比明显。两个人影被拉长在了墙壁上
Vivienne愤怒地将酒杯砸碎在桌子上。Vivienne穿着丝绸垂感上衣，黑色包臀裙，酒红色丝袜，酒红色丝巾围在脖子上，脚上是黑色高跟鞋。手里拿着一支香烟。
column8: Vivienne (rage barely contained): He took her. He took the Omega!

column3: 酒杯破碎，酒水四溅。
Adrian靠在椅背上，神情带着愤怒和仇恨
Adrian的手狠狠地捏住椅子扶手
Adrian愤怒地起身，看着Vivienne，说
column8: Adrian (measured): She grew up in the human world. Didn't she.

column3: Vivienne吐出一口烟，说
Adrian的嘴角扬起，开始凶狠地笑
column8:
Adrian (one word at a time): What does the werewolf clan fear most? Abandoning the bloodline... becoming one with the humans.
Adrian (voice turning cold): An Omega raised by humans, brought into the inner circle of the clan by Caius — what do you think the elders will make of that?

column3: Vivienne听着Adrian的计划，眼神逐渐变得惊讶
Adrian语速越来越快，又变得慢了起来，继续带着狠劲说
column8:
Adrian (one word at a time): What does the werewolf clan fear most? Abandoning the bloodline... becoming one with the humans.
Adrian (voice turning cold): An Omega raised by humans, brought into the inner circle of the clan by Caius — what do you think the elders will make of that?

column3: Vivienne倒吸一口凉气，不过她反应了过来，说
column8: Vivienne: He's in league with humans. Using the Omega as a cover story —

column3: Adrian看着Vivienne，眼神中有一丝疯狂，说
column8: Adrian: We fabricate some 'evidence.' Make it convincing. And while we're at it — we bring the wolf hunters in.

column3: Vivienne看着Adrian，逐渐露出笑容，扭曲地笑
Vivienne走向Adrian，邪恶微笑着说
column8: Vivienne (low, almost laughing): Chaos from within... pressure from without... hahaha — my brilliant boy. The Alpha throne will be yours. It will be yours.

column8: Vivienne (low, almost laughing): Chaos from within... pressure from without... hahaha — my brilliant boy. The Alpha throne will be yours. It will be yours.

column3: Adrian变态的笑容
墙上两道影子变得扭曲，重叠
索尔庄园议事厅，非常大。墙上刻划着狼族的图腾，烛火摇曳
烛火，图腾，背对着众人的Caius
人群分成了两边，十几个家族成员靠墙站立，神情各异，有怀疑，有愤怒，也有小声说话的
几位长老坐在人群前面看着Caius
一份文件被拍在了Caius身后的桌上/长老A开始站起来输出
column8: Elder A (sharp): Caius. What is the meaning of this report? It states clearly — you have been secretly selling our clan's territorial coordinates and member identities to a human wolf-hunting organization.

column3: 众人议论声音变大
长老B也向前一步，指着Caius开始输出。节奏从快到慢，再由慢到快
column8:
Elder B (cold, cutting): And that's not all. This so-called fated Omega you went to such lengths to find — a woman raised entirely by humans, who speaks like a human, lives like a human. Whatever wolf blood she carries has long since been diluted beyond recognition.
△ 他停顿了一下。声音里压抑着怒火。
Elder B (cont.): What does our clan forbid above all else? Assimilation with humans. The abandonment of our bloodline. You bring this woman into the clan and call her your fated Omega, call her the cure for your Alpha rage — isn't that just too convenient?

column3: 长老C侧身站了出来，阴阳怪气，冷静地说
column8: Elder C (flat): All this trouble. All this searching. And in the end, you bring home an Omega raised by humans and install her at the heart of the clan. Alpha — what exactly are you trying to do?

column3: 议论的声音消失，随即爆发开来/Caius回了一点点头，眼神阴暗
众人表情沉着，有的人在激烈地说话，有的人低着头，怕Alpha冒火给他两皮坨
Caius转过身来，议论声音立马就减弱了，他冷酷地环视了四周。声音很低沉，但是很明确
column8: Caius (ice-cold, one word at a time): This report. Is a forgery.

column3: 长老A还不知死活地输出
column8: Elder A (cold laugh, sliding the document forward): Then where's your proof?

column3: Caius的眼里生出了愤怒的种子
Caius皮坨捏紧了
议事厅的门外传来了引擎声，低沉，逼近，所有人都看向门外
门被打开，Dante从门外快步走了进来
Dante走到Caius身前，脸色苍白，眉头紧皱，说
column8: Dante (barely above a whisper): Alpha — the werewolf hunters have surrounded the outer perimeter. Armed. Silver bullets.

column3: Dante对着Caius紧张地说

column3: 所有人看向Caius
几个家族成员向后退去
家族成员脸色惨白
Caius的眼神缓慢扫视
庄园大门被推开，门缝中出现猎狼人小队
月光顺着门缝展开，猎狼人的影子出现在地面上
